storage: Small: reference layers re-read weekly or monthly; raw.record grows only by changed versions (osm_valley). roads.osm_street: about 23k ways, 11 MB with its indexes; roads.osm_paving, osm_parking and osm_walk_node: about 125k ways, 4k lots and stalls and 66k nodes, 75 MB with their indexes freshly loaded; all versioned in place (no raw.record copies), and a reload rewrites every row it brings, so up to about twice that until vacuumed. roads.developed_land: the current CDL year's developed land, about 200k polygons, 62 MB with its index; each build ($TVT_ARCHIVE/roads/developed/<id>/) is about 8 MB, and old ones can be removed once a newer one is loaded. The real-width roads (roads-build, roads 0003): about 190 MB with indexes, replaced whole by each build (up to twice that until vacuumed); each roads-export is about 165 MB ($TVT_ARCHIVE/roads/export/<build>/: keep the newest two). The last two OpenStreetMap extracts are kept in $TVT_ARCHIVE/osm/ (about 130 MB each), and the valley cut of the newest in $TVT_ARCHIVE/osm/cut/ (about 32 MB).
ethics: OpenStreetMap is ODbL: credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors", and anything published from it stays ODbL. Geofabrik's robots.txt disallows scripted downloads, so extracts are downloaded by hand and there is no download code. ACHD's and ITD's layers state no license: used internally, credited. ACHD's bike network's free-text Comments and FieldNotes stay in roads.bike_facility_note, out of every view, export, tile and card. osm_paving's materials read developed land from USDA NASS's Cropland Data Layer (public domain; credit "USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer <year>"): farm's archived copy of the owner's hand download, traced in the worker image (the raster is never decoded in the ingest image), never served as tiles; an export of the materials lists it as an input, with roads.developed_build's year and sha256.
